bioAdditions: The Pennsylvania death index for 1938 lists Regina Pringle of Plymouth (Luzerne Co., county code 40), died 19 Dec 1938, certificate file 110395 (S1). The FamilySearch tree names her Regina Stiers (also Styer), born 30 Nov 1862, daughter of John K. Stiers (1830-1893, d. Larksville) and Jane Edwards (1837-1929, d. Plymouth). It shows her at Danville, Montour Co., in 1870 and 1880, married to John S. Pringle in 1887, and living in Plymouth in 1900 and 1910. She was widowed when John died at 25 East Shawnee Avenue, Plymouth, on 22 Dec 1933, and was buried at Forty Fort (S2). Bradsby (1893) confirms that John, son of Andrew and Catherine (Scott) Pringle, married 'Miss Regina Stires' (S3).
